newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Seven says scope for improved profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Seven says scope for improved profit.

text.p: Seven Network Ltd chairman Kerry Stokes said on Thursday there was scope for further improvement in the company's profitablity after last financial year's record net earnings of A$115 million.

"The company's profitablity in 1995/96 was a significant improvement on 1994/95. However, we believe there is further scope for improvement - improvement which will strengthen shareholder value," he told the annual meeting in Melbroune.
Stokes said Seven, 14 percent owned by News Corp Ltd, would focus in the current year on cutting costs and improving advertising revenue.
"Our focus is firmly on further improvement in our management of the network's costs and the development of revenue in what is an increasingly competitive environment," he said.
Stokes said Seven's pursuit of legal action against pay tv operator Optus Vision was an indication of the company's resolve to ensure protection of the interests of all its shareholders.
"We are not pursuing this legal action for any reason other than our obligation to defend and protect the interests of your company," Stokes told the meeting.
